_comment: Class A buddy (issue #227): another TAPPaaS PBS this server PULLS from. Copy to /home/tappaas/config/remote-<name>.json, edit, then: backup-manage.sh add-remote <name>. API credentials are NOT stored here — they are prompted at onboarding.
name: lars
_groupFilter_note: ADR-012 §3.6 subset (#389): pull only PART of the source. A PBS group-filter as a string or array of strings, e.g. "type:vm" or ["group:vm/101","group:vm/102"]. Empty/absent pulls everything.
